column1: # Hand-curated per-component MK spectral types — literature values for
# WDS components that neither SIMBAD's per-component cross-IDs nor
# AT-HYG carry. SIMBAD enumerates Algol's WDS components as A/F/G only,
# so its per-component sp_type join can never supply Aa2's K0IV; the
# AT-HYG fallback inherits the system primary's type. Stage 6 reads
# this file as the top tier of the spectral cascade
#   component   — component designator EXACTLY as emitted in the
#                 multiples.tsv comp column, i.e. the raw WDS pair-cell
#                 form. WDS truncates repeated stems: Algol's Aa1,2 pair
#                 emits its secondary as comp="2" (canonical Aa2).
#   source      — literature reference for the classification.
